description: SFX key-to-prompt map. Keys are used in script sfx_prompts arrays. Prompts are sent to ElevenLabs sound-generation API.

trip_whoosh.prompt: quick whooshing sound of someone tripping and sliding forward, cartoon style

fall_thud.prompt: cartoon thud impact sound of a character falling down, soft and comedic

victory_chime.prompt: upbeat success chime sound effect, bright and celebratory, short

sparkle_pop.prompt: magical sparkle pop sound with light shimmer, like a star appearing

explode_pop.prompt: fun cartoon explosion pop sound, energetic and punchy, not scary

shatter_pop.prompt: glass shattering into pieces sound effect, light and crisp, cartoon style

whoosh_slide.prompt: quick slide whoosh transition sound, smooth and fast

magic_whoosh.prompt: magical power-up whoosh sound, mystical and energetic with rising pitch

power_chime.prompt: heroic power activation chime, strong and triumphant, short burst

cheer_crowd.prompt: small cheerful crowd reaction, brief applause and cheer, warm and enthusiastic

fail_boop.prompt: cartoon fail boop sound, gentle negative feedback, not harsh

ding.prompt: clean bright notification ding sound, single tone, pleasant

neon_flicker.prompt: electric neon light flickering sound, buzzing and zapping, brief

type_click.prompt: fast typewriter clicking sound, mechanical keyboard typing burst

level_up.prompt: video game level up sound effect, ascending tones with final triumphant note

rocket_launch.prompt: small rocket launching sound effect, whoosh and distant roar, energetic

pen_writing.prompt: pen or marker writing on paper sound, scratchy and natural, brief burst

camera_shutter.prompt: smartphone camera shutter sound, quick snap, modern mobile style

wrong_buzzer.prompt: wrong answer game show buzzer sound, short and clear, not too harsh

correct_ping.prompt: correct answer ping sound, bright and positive, quick double tone
